seed: A highlight used to be offered two rows one above the other, both called Outline. They painted different colours and both switches wrote the same ring, so picking either was a guess. Since 2026-09-08 there is no Outline row anywhere: a line round a layer is a Border you add in Effects, and the highlight's ring is that same Border. This walk draws a highlight, reads what it is offered, adds ONE border, and checks the ring it draws; then it draws a rectangle, which arrives with a Border of its own.

steps.note: THE TEST: a lone highlight. Appearance must offer Color, its wash, with no switch on it, and Effects must be empty: a highlight arrives with no ring, and there is nowhere else a ring could be hiding.
ONE Border row, and a real ring round the highlight the moment it lands. Two rows here would be the old bug back.
the switch pressed: the ring goes, the wash stays.
the regression check: a rectangle offers Fill in Appearance and the Border it came out of the tool wearing in Effects, that Border carrying the switch and the width.
